headline: Approved fire alarm and sprinkler inspection contract with Precision Alarm Corp., gym wall padding contract, and Hazard Building boiler replacement.
summary: Three fundraisers were approved, including a Class of 2030 car wash and a Matunuck Elementary piano concert. Math proficiency reached 54.1%, the district’s highest recorded result, according to a state testing report.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including purchase orders over $10,350, 6-0.
Approved the Class of 2030 car wash fundraiser 6-0.
Approved the Class of 2030 “30 for 30” donation fundraiser 6-0.
Approved the Matunuck Elementary holiday piano concert fundraiser 6-0.
Approved the fire alarm, sprinkler and suppression system inspection and repair contract with Precision Alarm Corp. 6-0.
Approved the gym wall padding contract with National Equipment and Facility Solutions 5-1.
Approved the Hazard Building boiler replacement bid award to Industrial Burner 6-0.
